system.description:
While your Brainwave Clock is full, you may use an action to erase all of its sections. If you do, you may choose one option:

  • You deal 20 physical damage to every enemy that is present on the scene.

  • You deal 30 physical damage to a single enemy you can see.

This amount increases by 10 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 20 if you are level 40 or higher.

Resource: @CLOCK[brainwave-clock reset]{Reset Brainwave Clock}
Targets Suffer: @DMG[&step(20,30,40) physical]{20|30|40 Physical (Single)} or @DMG[&step(30,40,50) physical]{30|40|50 Physical (Multi)}
